subject.title: perf: avoid event-loop stall during embedded_run bootstrap-context

question: Should this PR land as the scoped bootstrap-context mitigation for the linked event-loop stall, despite replacing fs.glob and yielding between bootstrap hook handlers?
rationale: The patch appears correct for the focused stall, but it changes existing bootstrap glob matching mechanics and hook-chain interleaving in ways tests cannot fully settle for user configs and session context bytes.

options.title: Land Scoped Mitigation
options.body: Accept the compatibility and session-state tradeoff as the right narrow fix for the reported bootstrap-context stall once maintainer review is satisfied.

options.title: Require Connected Runtime Proof
options.body: Ask for a live embedded_run or channel proof showing bootstrap-context no longer starves message delivery before merge.

options.title: Hold For Broader Architecture
options.body: Defer this branch in favor of a larger worker/offload design, leaving the narrower bootstrap-context stall unresolved longer.

recommendation.title: Land Scoped Mitigation
recommendation.body: Accept the compatibility and session-state tradeoff as the right narrow fix for the reported bootstrap-context stall once maintainer review is satisfied.
